viewports.name: desktop
rules: Expanded shell sidebar and persistent header/footer.
Multi-panel screens use split views or grids.
Graph detail panels remain visible beside canvas.

viewports.name: tablet
rules: Sidebar condenses to icon rail with tooltips.
Detail panels become drawers or bottom sheets.
Kanban and tables may scroll horizontally.

viewports.name: mobile
rules: Tables become card lists and tabs may become accordions.
Drawers become full-screen overlays and graph-heavy screens offer tree fallback.

browser_allowed: Go REST API from gmind serve
Static embedded assets from the Go binary
Client cache for read-only offline state
Local queue metadata for pending writes
browser_forbidden: Local git command or repository read
backend_responsibilities: Aggregate FrankenSQLite, Zvec, local git, GitHub, FastCode, shell, and CI data.
Return normalized JSON and event stream payloads through Go REST endpoints.
Enforce authorization, rate limits, and audit logging before browser data is returned.

accessibility_defaults: WCAG AA contrast and visible focus indicators.
Keyboard access for routes, tabs, filters, tables, cards, graph controls, and dialogs.
Every state color has visible text label and aria-label where status is compact.
Error, offline, saving, and sync messages use aria-live polite unless destructive.
Escape closes modal, drawer, dropdown, and command palette through shared keyboard handling.

boundary_states.default: Render live API data with route-specific interactions enabled.
boundary_states.loading: Use layout-matched skeletons; avoid standalone spinner-only pages.
boundary_states.empty: Show specific empty copy plus create, clear filter, reindex, or retry CTA.
boundary_states.error: Show concise cause, retry action, and safe route fallback.
boundary_states.offline: Show top banner, preserve navigation, use read-only cache, queue eligible writes.
boundary_states.forbidden: Explain missing permission and provide safe return action.
boundary_states.partial: Show local graph or cached data while enrichment continues.
boundary_states.saving: Disable edited controls, show inline progress, rollback on API error.
boundary_states.not_found: Show missing entity message with parent-list link.
boundary_states.sync_conflict: Let user choose Keep local edit or Use server version with audit trail.

responsive_constraints.shell: Desktop expanded, tablet icon rail, mobile overlay.
responsive_constraints.board: Desktop horizontal kanban, tablet horizontal scroll, mobile card/list stack.
responsive_constraints.graphs: Desktop canvas plus detail, tablet bottom sheet, mobile tree or simplified graph.
responsive_constraints.approval: Desktop queue/evidence/decision split, tablet stacked, mobile fixed decision bar.
responsive_constraints.documents: Desktop tree plus content, tablet selector plus content, mobile list/detail swap.

realtime.polling_interval: 3 to 5 seconds for events table derived updates

actions.label: Load route data through Go REST API
Update hash-selected tab, scenario, anchor, preset, or board
Retry or manually refresh current route data
Retry failed API load from error, empty, or recovery state
Run global or explorer search
Navigate to task detail
Navigate to Trace Explorer or Beads Traversal context
Navigate to Document Viewer
Save editable task field through PUT /api/tasks/:id
Save selected task bulk updates through PUT /api/tasks/bulk
Persist Kanban drag/drop status change
Submit approve, reject, or request changes with audit reason
Save PI planning sandbox changes
Submit required PI confidence vote
Enter offline read-only mode
Rehydrate queued edits after health recovers
Keep local queued edit during sync conflict
Replace queued edit with server version
Return to last safe route or workspace shell
Open drawer, bottom sheet, command palette, or mobile nav
Close overlay with Escape, close button, or safe outside click

required_assertions: data-ds-id is stable and unique within this contract.
Route and hash anchors deep-link without losing shell state.
Browser data comes from Go REST API only.
Boundary states have specific copy and recovery affordance.
Responsive behavior matches desktop, tablet, and mobile rules.

acceptance_assertions.statement: Browser routes use only Go REST API; no direct FrankenSQLite, Zvec, git, gh, FastCode, shell, or CI access.
All PRD §8 showcase routes and listed Core mappings are represented by a stable screen id, route, ds identity, states, data flow, and component tree.
Default, loading, empty, error, offline, and forbidden are available for every user-facing screen, with specialized states where required.
Desktop, tablet, and mobile constraints are explicit for shell, board, graph, approval, document, and table layouts.
Keyboard, focus, labels, aria-live status, and non-color-only state semantics are required before Stage 2 implementation passes.
